environment.description: Same ECS Fargate task, same code deployed. The task role (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/order-processor-gated) has an inline policy with dynamodb:PutItem and dynamodb:GetItem on the OrderEvents table, but with a Condition block: dynamodb:LeadingKeys requires the PK to match 'TENANT#${aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}' and dynamodb:Attributes is restricted to [PK, SK, body, tier, status]. Additionally, the role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:policy/ProcessorBoundary) that denies sts:AssumeRole, iam:*, lambda:InvokeFunction, and ec2:* actions. The VPC has no NAT gateway and no VPC endpoints except for SQS and DynamoDB gateway endpoint. Security group egress rules allow only port 443 to the com.amazonaws.us-east-1.dynamodb and com.amazonaws.us-east-1.sqs prefix lists. The ECS task definition sets readonlyRootFilesystem: true and drops all Linux capabilities.

config.iam_policy: Allow dynamodb:PutItem,GetItem on table/OrderEvents WITH Condition: dynamodb:LeadingKeys = ['TENANT#${aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}'], dynamodb:Attributes = ['PK','SK','body','tier','status']
config.permissions_boundary: Deny sts:AssumeRole, iam:*, lambda:InvokeFunction, ec2:*, s3:*
config.vpc_config: No NAT gateway, no internet gateway route, only DynamoDB and SQS VPC gateway endpoints
config.security_group_egress: Port 443 only to pl-02cd2c6b (DynamoDB) and pl-63a5400a (SQS) prefix lists
config.ecs_task_config: readonlyRootFilesystem: true, drop ALL capabilities, no EFS mounts
